name: Access Only
summary: Prepaid month-by-month dialup ISP ('no strings attached', ~$13.75/mo in 2002, all-capital POPs); retail site live through ~2009, defunct c.2009-2010.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture 19 Oct 2002 (accessonly.com.au); no earlier captures 1996-2002. Month-by-month prepaid unlimited dialup, advertised at $13.75/mo in the 2002 snapshot.
The full retail homepage was still being captured through 27 Oct 2009 (with intermittent 404s/parked stubs), so the ISP operated far later than the previously listed ~2006; defunct c.2009-2010.
source: Wayback CDX for accessonly.com.au (retail homepage through Oct 2009): http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=accessonly.com.au
